# PrismWave R501_fix

## English

- Refined the glass-style UI for a cleaner, more premium Windows player look.
- Switched the app font to Resource Han Rounded for Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- Removed the red tint from the main play button background and the playback progress bar; both now use white glass styling.
- Improved automatic lyrics matching performance on the full play page by reducing repeated load triggers, preferring fast LRCLIB results, limiting QQ fallback waits, and checking sidecar `.lrc/.qrc` files before embedded lyrics.
- Updated the app and installer version to `R501_fix`.

## 中文

- 进一步调整玻璃拟态界面，让 Windows 播放器观感更简约高级。
- 将全局字体切换为 Resource Han Rounded，覆盖简体与繁体中文。
- 移除主播放键背景与播放进度条的红色调，统一为白色玻璃质感。
- 优化 fullplay 页面自动歌词匹配速度：减少重复触发、优先使用更快的 LRCLIB 结果、收紧 QQ 兜底等待，并优先检查旁置 `.lrc/.qrc` 文件。
- 应用与安装包版本同步为 `R501_fix`。
